title: Two new species of semi-terrestrial crabs from the genus Laevimon Yeo & Ng, 2005 (Decapoda: Brachyura: Potamidae) from northern Vietnam, with a redescription of Laevimon tankiense (Đặng & Trần, 1992)
content:
Abstract
Two new species of freshwater crab from the genus Laevimon Yeo & Ng, 2005 are described from northern Vietnam. The new species possess external morphologies and gonopod structures that are similar to those of the two known species, Laevimon kottelati Yeo & Ng, 2005 and L. tankiense (Đặng & Trần, 1992), but can be distinguished by differences in the life colouration, and structures of the posterior margin of the epistome, male thoracic sternum, vulva, and first gonopod. The poorly known L. tankiense was collected from the type locality and is redescribed. A key for all four species of Laevimon is provided.
